1. Edit /home/toxic/estate/config/herd.yaml to add oracle-judge-sovereign alias that forwards to sovereign/free on port 25104
2. Edit /home/toxic/estate/agents/oracle-market/bin/oracle_ask.py to add "oracle-judge-sovereign" to DEFAULT_JUDGES list

For herd.yaml, add after oracle-judge-c (around line 218):
```
oracle-judge-sovereign:
  cmd: python3 /home/toxic/estate/config/herd.d/alias-shim.py --port ${PORT} --herd http://127.0.0.1:25104 --target sovereign/free --name oracle-judge-sovereign
  description: "Oracle judge sovereign (alias -> sovereign/free free pool) -- races all free models maximally"
  metadata:
    alias_of: sovereign/free
    role: oracle-judge
```

For oracle_ask.py, find DEFAULT_JUDGES list and add "oracle-judge-sovereign" to it.

After edits, restart herd: pitchfork restart sovereign/herd

# =============================================================================

# Config: /home/toxic/estate/config/herd.yaml (canonical; llama-swap.yaml symlinks here)

captureBuffer: 15
globalTTL: 600
startPort: 25001
includeAliasesInList: true
sendLoadingState: true

store:
  path: /home/toxic/.local/share/llama-swap/store.db

performance:
  enable: true

hooks:

# Flock (:8000) is the unified multi-provider remote-API/completions subsystem.
# DISABLED 2026-09-20 (provider-surgeon): flock :25193 cloud upstream is dead -
# NVIDIA account returns 404/410/502 on every probed chat model; the flock daemon
# itself runs with zero upstream env keys. Re-enable when flock upstream is healthy.
# (flock daemon keeps running under pitchfork for the TAU flock extension.)
# RE-ENABLED 2026-09-20 ~03:10 MDT (provider-surgeon): flock upstream completions
# verified live via 127.0.0.1:25193 with FLOCK_API_KEY. Only the 3 model IDs
# below returned real completions in the probe; the other 100 flock-advertised
# IDs 404 upstream (stale) and are deliberately NOT mapped. Re-probe before adding more.
# DISABLED 2026-09-20 ~03:20 MDT (provider-surgeon): the flock delegation advertises
# ALL 103 upstream model IDs (discovery cannot be restricted to modelMap), and ~100
# of them 404 upstream (stale). Use the flock-direct peer below instead, which

# itself runs with zero upstream env keys. Re-enable when flock upstream is healthy.
# (flock daemon keeps running under pitchfork for the TAU flock extension.)
# RE-ENABLED 2026-09-20 ~03:10 MDT (provider-surgeon): flock upstream completions
# verified live via 127.0.0.1:25193 with FLOCK_API_KEY. Only the 3 model IDs
# below returned real completions in the probe; the other 100 flock-advertised
# IDs 404 upstream (stale) and are deliberately NOT mapped. Re-probe before adding more.

# Canonical secrets for provider keyEnvs (FLOCK_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, ...).
